Given: A visitor has no active session and the Rate Wealth DEV app is available
When: They open a protected route directly
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open /home in a clean browser context; 2. Repeat for /financial-plans, /plan-select, /wealth, /budget, and /settings; 3. Observe the final URL and login controls
Then_Expected: Each route redirects to the Okta login flow and presents usable sign-in controls; protected content is not exposed
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-01

Given: A registered QA user is on the Okta login page
When: They submit valid credentials
Detailed_Steps: 1. Enter the QA email and password; 2. Submit; 3. Complete any required human MFA; 4. Wait for the app home screen; 5. Reload the page
Then_Expected: The user lands in the authenticated app; the session survives reload without a blank page or repeated SSO redirect

Given: A registered QA user is on the login page
When: They submit an incorrect password or an unknown email
Detailed_Steps: 1. Submit an incorrect password for a known user; 2. Repeat using an unknown email; 3. Compare the visible error and page state
Then_Expected: Both attempts show a generic credential error, do not authenticate, and do not reveal whether the email is registered
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-01

Given: A valid authenticated QA session exists

Then_Expected: The app refreshes silently and remains usable without an Okta redirect loop or blank page
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated simulated-expiration check; genuine aged-session behavior not yet verified

Given: The registration page is open

Then_Expected: Continue is unavailable for blank or malformed email; valid email advances to the name step without disclosing account existence
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-01

Given: A user is authenticated and the app shell is loaded
When: They navigate using every sidebar destination
Detailed_Steps: 1. Visit Home, Plan Summary, Financial Plans, Financial Snapshot, Day-to-Day Money, Risk Management, Transactions, Accounts, Student Loans, Investments, Home Ownership, and Settings; 2. Record URL and page heading for each

Given: A user is authenticated and sidebar groups are visible
When: They expand and collapse each sidebar group
Detailed_Steps: 1. Record each group aria-expanded value; 2. Click the group trigger; 3. Verify aria-expanded changes; 4. Click again and verify it returns
Then_Expected: Each group toggles state accessibly and its child links become available only when expanded
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-02

Given: A user is authenticated

Then_Expected: Unknown or legacy routes redirect to /home; valid Day-to-Day Money and Student Loans routes remain /budget and /studentloans
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-02; earlier reported defects were false positives from using legacy paths

Given: A completed-profile QA user is authenticated
When: They review Home and Snapshot financial summaries
Detailed_Steps: 1. Record Home Financial Net Worth; 2. Open Financial Snapshot; 3. Record Net Wealth and its breakdown; 4. Compare labels and calculation inputs
Then_Expected: Each amount is internally consistent with its stated definition; distinct calculations are clearly labeled and explained

Given: A completed-profile QA user has zero income in the test fixture
When: They open Plan Summary
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open Plan Summary; 2. Inspect each period and progress table; 3. Search visible values for Infinity or NaN
Then_Expected: Percentages and totals remain finite and meaningful; no Infinity or NaN is rendered
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-02

Given: A completed-profile QA user is authenticated
When: They inspect Snapshot tabs and projected wealth graph
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open /wealth; 2. Select each available tab; 3. Verify each tab's content; 4. Inspect projected wealth axis labels
Then_Expected: Each tab renders relevant content; axis labels are distinct, ordered, and accurately formatted
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-02; duplicate rounded tick labels are a known UX defect

Given: A completed-profile user is on Accounts with known test balances
When: They review totals and open the manual-add dialog
Detailed_Steps: 1. Record listed asset and debt balances; 2. Verify Asset Total and Debt Total; 3. Open Add Account Manually; 4. Verify Add is disabled before type selection; 5. Select a type; 6. Close the dialog
Then_Expected: Totals equal the corresponding listed balances; Add is gated until a type is selected; the dialog opens and closes without leaving a blocking overlay

Given: A completed-profile user is on Transactions
When: They use filters and open Add Transaction Manually
Detailed_Steps: 1. Exercise search, transaction type, and date-range filters; 2. Open Add Transaction Manually; 3. Submit with required fields blank; 4. Enter alphabetic characters in Amount
Then_Expected: Filters expose and apply their documented options; the form opens; empty submission is blocked; letters are rejected from Amount
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-03; TRANS_REVIEW PATCH 404 is a known API defect

Given: A completed-profile user has known income, expenses, debt, contributions, and premiums
When: They switch budget views and verify arithmetic
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open /budget; 2. Check Income and Expenses tabs; 3. Toggle monthly/annual view; 4. Add income using the form; 5. Compare Available Funds with income minus all outflows
Then_Expected: Views and period selector update correctly; forms have meaningful labels; Available Funds equals income minus expenses, contributions, debt payments, and premiums
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-03/rw-05; CALC-005 discrepancy of two dollars is a known defect

Given: A completed-profile user is authenticated
When: They inspect existing premiums and open Add Premium
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open /risk; 2. Review premium rows and coverage summary; 3. Open Add Premium; 4. Inspect form title and fields; 5. Close the form
Then_Expected: Premium and coverage data render; Add Premium opens a usable form and closes cleanly
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-03

Given: A completed-profile user is authenticated
When: They open each calculator tile
Detailed_Steps: 1. Visit /studentloans, /investments, and /homebuying; 2. Open each listed calculator tile; 3. Confirm the calculator heading and main inputs; 4. Return and continue through all tiles
Then_Expected: All 13 calculator tiles open their intended calculator without HTTP errors or blank content
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-03

Given: A fresh onboarding QA account is authenticated and onboarding is not yet completed
When: They validate required Basics fields and ZIP format
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open Profile Builder; 2. Clear DOB and ZIP; 3. Click Next; 4. Enter letters, six digits, and a four-digit ZIP in separate attempts; 5. Enter a valid five-digit ZIP
Then_Expected: Required fields block progression; ZIP accepts only up to five digits; a four-digit ZIP receives a format-specific message
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-04; generic required message for four-digit ZIP is a known UX defect

Given: A fresh onboarding account is at the DOB step
When: They enter boundary DOB values
Detailed_Steps: 1. Enter a future date and attempt Next; 2. Enter 01/01/1900 and attempt Next; 3. Enter a plausible valid date; 4. Complete the step and inspect Wealth Score
Then_Expected: Future and implausibly old dates are rejected; valid DOB advances; Wealth Score never displays NaN
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-04; invalid DOB acceptance and NaN score are known defects

Given: A fresh onboarding account is at Income
When: They test salary validation and unit conversions
Detailed_Steps: 1. Enter annual salary of 65000; 2. Record monthly equivalent; 3. Continue to Budget Overview and compare; 4. Enter letters and a negative value; 5. Enter an implausibly large value
Then_Expected: Conversions use consistent rounding across screens; nonnumeric, negative, and unreasonable values are rejected
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-04; truncation mismatch and missing upper-bound validation are known defects

Given: A fresh onboarding account is at Expenses
When: They switch periods and manage expense rows
Detailed_Steps: 1. Review all default categories; 2. Record monthly values; 3. Switch to annual and back; 4. Add a category if supported; 5. Verify accessible names for all inputs
Then_Expected: Monthly/annual values convert consistently; all expense inputs have programmatic accessible names
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-04; 16 of 18 expense inputs were reported unlabeled

Given: A fresh onboarding account is moving through Profile Builder
When: They navigate Back and Next across valid answers
Detailed_Steps: 1. Enter valid Basics data; 2. Continue to Education; 3. Answer the degree question; 4. Continue and navigate Back; 5. Verify prior answers; 6. Search and select a profession; 7. Complete required stage questions
Then_Expected: Valid answers persist when navigating Back; selections enable progression; the flow reaches the final onboarding step without lost state
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-04; MFA can cause the suite to skip

Given: The dedicated plan-builder account is authenticated and has fewer than three plans
When: They create a manual plan with a valid name
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open /plan-select; 2. Choose Manually; 3. Enter a unique plan name; 4. Verify setup steps and default Retirement goal; 5. Save and Exit; 6. Return to Financial Plans and reopen it
Then_Expected: The plan is created with the supplied name, appears in the list, and can be reopened with saved data
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-05

Given: The plan-builder account is below its three-plan limit
When: They try to proceed with blank or whitespace-only plan names
Detailed_Steps: 1. Start a manual plan; 2. Leave name blank and attempt to continue; 3. Restart and enter spaces only; 4. Attempt to continue
Then_Expected: Both inputs are rejected with clear validation; no default-named or empty plan is silently created
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-05; blank name silently defaulting to My Financial Plan is a known defect

Given: The plan-builder account has room for another plan
When: They cancel manual plan creation before saving
Detailed_Steps: 1. Record current plan count; 2. Choose Manually; 3. Cancel or leave before Save and Exit; 4. Return to Financial Plans; 5. Compare plan count and cards
Then_Expected: An abandoned flow leaves no persisted draft and does not consume one of the three plan slots
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-05; immediate draft persistence is a known defect

Given: The plan-builder account has a disposable plan
When: They exercise plan card actions
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open Actions; 2. Verify View, Edit, Implement, Copy, Rename, Delete; 3. Rename and verify title; 4. Copy and verify duplicate; 5. Attempt Implement on incomplete plan; 6. Delete a disposable plan
Then_Expected: Actions work as labeled; incomplete plans cannot be implemented; destructive deletion asks for confirmation
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-05; Implement enabled on incomplete plans and immediate Delete are known defects

Given: The plan-builder account has two or more plans
When: They compare plans and test the plan cap
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open Compare; 2. Verify selectable plans and checkbox labels; 3. Try comparison with fewer than two selected; 4. Select two plans; 5. Create plans until the cap is reached; 6. Attempt another creation
Then_Expected: Comparison requires two plans and all choices are labeled; the three-plan cap prevents additional plans with clear feedback
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-05; unlabeled compare checkboxes are a known accessibility defect

Given: A named plan is in progress with valid profile data
When: They complete every wizard step and review the simulation
Detailed_Steps: 1. Visit each wizard step in displayed order; 2. Enter or confirm valid data; 3. Record failed network requests; 4. Select Review Plan; 5. Wait for simulation; 6. Inspect all six preview tabs; 7. Confirm plan name
Then_Expected: Each step remains in the wizard and saves successfully; preview loads with populated content and supplied plan name; no API errors occur
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-05; liabilities PUT 500, portfolio GET 404, and preview title mismatch are known defects

Given: A named plan is at the Life Event/Goal step
When: They inspect the event picker
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open the event picker; 2. Compare entries with the documented 14 event types; 3. Open each type and record its money fields and labels
Then_Expected: All 14 documented types are available and each form exposes understandable, labeled fields
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated discovery coverage in rw-06

Given: A plan is at a life-event form with one or more currency fields
When: They submit boundary values for every event type
Detailed_Steps: 1. Repeat for each of the 14 event types; 2. For every amount field enter blank, zero, and a negative number; 3. Attempt Save or Next Step after each value; 4. Enter a valid positive amount
Then_Expected: Blank, zero, and negative values are rejected according to product rules with clear errors; valid amounts save and advance
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-06; confirmed defect: zero and negative values are accepted across all 14 types; confirm business rule for legitimate zero down payment with product

Given: A plan contains a saved goal, including a zero-value goal for diagnostic coverage
When: They open Goal Ranking and Review Plan
Detailed_Steps: 1. Save the goal; 2. Navigate to Goal Ranking; 3. Wait for loading to settle; 4. Select Review Plan; 5. Inspect goal table and preview
Then_Expected: Goal Ranking and preview resolve to usable content; valid goal details persist; invalid values should not poison the model
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated in rw-06; prior blank-page/infinite-loader issue was not reproduced on 2026-09-30

Given: An authenticated QA user can navigate the primary pages
When: They load Home, Transactions, and the plan wizard while network requests are observed
Detailed_Steps: 1. Clear network log; 2. Load Home; 3. Load Transactions; 4. Step through plan wizard; 5. Record status codes, endpoint, and user-visible impact
Then_Expected: Critical user journeys produce no unexpected 4xx/5xx responses; known failures are tracked and do not silently break displayed data
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated network checks exist; recorded TRANS_REVIEW 404, liabilities PUT 500, portfolio GET 404, and tracking endpoint 500 remain known findings

Given: A completed-profile user can access the primary app screens
When: They inspect accessible names and keyboard operation
Detailed_Steps: 1. Inspect header phone and mail buttons; 2. Inspect expense inputs; 3. Inspect plan comparison checkboxes; 4. Navigate dialogs and key actions using keyboard; 5. Verify focus visibility and labels
Then_Expected: Interactive controls have accessible names, labels, visible focus, and usable keyboard operation
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Partially automated; unnamed header buttons, expense inputs, and comparison checkboxes are known defects

Given: The QA account has controlled known income, household expenses, debts, premiums, and contributions
When: They compare dashboard, budget, and plan calculations
Detailed_Steps: 1. Record source inputs; 2. Calculate expected monthly and annual totals independently; 3. Compare Home, Budget Overview, Plan Summary, and Plan Preview; 4. Repeat with zero income and one changed input
Then_Expected: All screens use consistent rounding and definitions; derived totals reconcile to the documented inputs; no NaN or Infinity values appear
Existing_Status_or_Notes: Automated arithmetic checks exist; known discrepancies include CALC-001, CALC-003, CALC-005

Given: A user is authenticated and the Rate Wealth DEV app is loaded
When: They inspect the common application shell across primary pages
Detailed_Steps: 1. Visit Home, Financial Plans, Snapshot, Budget, Accounts, and Settings; 2. On each page inspect product name/logo, header, sidebar, page title, and primary action; 3. Compare text and control styling against the approved Rate Wealth DEV reference
Then_Expected: Rate Wealth identity and shared shell remain consistent across pages; no broken logo, placeholder text, FitBUX-only leftover copy, or unstyled control appears
Existing_Status_or_Notes: New UI regression case; confirm exact branding against product-approved reference

Given: A user is authenticated and the sidebar is visible
When: They navigate, use browser Back/Forward, and toggle sidebar groups
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open Budget from the sidebar; 2. Verify the selected item indicates the current route; 3. Open Accounts; 4. Use browser Back then Forward; 5. Collapse and reopen the relevant sidebar group
Then_Expected: The active navigation state always matches the current route, browser history restores the expected page, and accordion state does not block navigation
Existing_Status_or_Notes: New UI-functional case; route coverage exists in rw-02 but active styling/history assertions are not explicit

Given: A user is authenticated on Home and has access to the main application pages
When: They use the app at desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport sizes
Detailed_Steps: 1. Set viewport to 1440x900; 2. Repeat at 768x1024 and 390x844; 3. Visit Home, Budget, Transactions, and Financial Plans at each size; 4. Open and close navigation and one dialog; 5. Check page edges and primary actions
Then_Expected: Content reflows without horizontal page overflow, clipped headings, overlapping controls, or inaccessible primary actions; mobile navigation and dialogs remain operable
Existing_Status_or_Notes: New responsive case; visual dimensions should be compared with approved responsive design, if available

Given: A user is on Accounts or Transactions with the corresponding manual-add action available
When: They open, validate, submit, and dismiss a dialog
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open Add Account Manually; 2. Verify focus enters the dialog and tab navigation stays usable; 3. Trigger required-field validation; 4. Close using the visible close control; 5. Repeat for Add Transaction Manually; 6. Reopen and dismiss with Escape or backdrop only if supported by the UI
Then_Expected: Dialogs are fully visible, controls are reachable, validation is shown next to the relevant fields, dismissal behaves consistently with supported controls, and closing leaves no overlay blocking the page
Existing_Status_or_Notes: New focused UI interaction case; dialog open/close is partly covered in rw-03

Given: A user navigates to data-backed pages under normal network conditions
When: They observe initial loading and a controlled recoverable request failure
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open Snapshot, Transactions, and Financial Plans; 2. Observe loading indicators until content is ready; 3. In a controlled test, fail one non-auth data request; 4. Observe the page and retry or navigate away and back
Then_Expected: Loading indicators resolve when requests finish; recoverable failures show a usable error or empty state rather than a permanent spinner, blank page, or stale overlay; retry/navigation restores the page when service recovers
Existing_Status_or_Notes: New UI-functional case; failure injection requires an approved test environment

Given: A user is on a calculator with valid default inputs and a visible result
When: They change a calculator input and restore the original value
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open a representative calculator from Student Loans, Investments, and Home Ownership; 2. Record the initial input and result; 3. Change one numeric input; 4. Trigger the documented calculate/update action if present; 5. Restore the original value
Then_Expected: Inputs accept valid values, results update to reflect changed inputs, labels and units remain visible, and restoring the value returns the original result within expected rounding
Existing_Status_or_Notes: New functional UI case; rw-03 currently verifies calculator launch and absence of HTTP errors, not calculations

Given: A user can access the primary Rate Wealth screens
When: They use keyboard navigation and inspect action feedback
Detailed_Steps: 1. Navigate the sidebar and page actions using Tab and Enter; 2. Open a dialog and move focus through its fields; 3. Submit a deliberately invalid form; 4. Correct the input and submit; 5. Inspect focus indicator, validation text, and success feedback
Then_Expected: Keyboard focus remains visible and logical; invalid actions explain how to recover; successful actions give clear confirmation; no action appears clickable without a working response

Given: The Rate Wealth DEV registration page is open

Then_Expected: All visible registration copy is spelled correctly

Detailed_Steps: 1. Submit the activation resend action once; 2. Confirm the page acknowledges the request; 3. Refresh the inbox normally; 4. Record whether an activation message arrives; 5. Do not treat the address as a usable account until activation completes

Given: The dedicated plan-builder account is authenticated and a named plan is in progress
When: They step through the available wizard sections while monitoring app API responses
Detailed_Steps: 1. Start a manual plan; 2. advance through each available section to Goal Ranking; 3. record non-ignored HTTP 4xx/5xx responses; 4. verify the wizard continues to Review Plan
Then_Expected: Wizard steps complete without unexpected app API errors and the user can reach Review Plan

Given: A named manual plan is at the final available wizard step
When: They review and wait for the financial plan simulation
Detailed_Steps: 1. Advance to Goal Ranking; 2. select Review Plan; 3. observe the simulation loader; 4. wait for the preview; 5. inspect the summary tabs and Implement Plan action
Then_Expected: The loader resolves to a populated preview with its summary tabs and no Complete All Steps blocker

Given: The dedicated planner account is authenticated and can create a manual plan
When: They complete a Buying a Home plan and implement it
Detailed_Steps: 1. Add Buying a Home with cost 450000 and down payment 90000; 2. complete all sections available to the profile through Goal Ranking; 3. select Review Plan and wait for the populated preview; 4. select Implement Plan; 5. inspect Home's Progress Towards Your Top Goal card and chart
Then_Expected: The plan completes and Home shows the down-payment goal with a visible progress chart and amount

Given: A saved in-progress plan contains a Buying a Home goal with cost 450000 and down payment 90000
When: They edit the goal, save, reopen, and inspect its values
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open the plan for editing; 2. change cost to 475000 and down payment to 95000; 3. advance and select Save and Exit; 4. reopen the same plan and inspect both values
Then_Expected: Edited values remain 475000 and 95000 after reopening

Given: A saved plan contains a Buying a Home goal
When: They delete the plan and create a fresh plan

Then_Expected: The new plan does not contain the deleted plan's goal

Given: An authenticated QA user opens Accounts and Plaid sandbox linking is available
When: They launch Plaid Link and connect the Platypus sandbox institution
Detailed_Steps: 1. Open Accounts; 2. select Connect Account and Add Financial Institution; 3. launch Plaid Link; 4. verify the Link iframe has a non-empty token; 5. search for Platypus; 6. complete the sandbox sign-in and linking flow
Then_Expected: Plaid Link initializes with a valid token and the Platypus account is linked and visible in Accounts
